evidence: One row per Year with ArrivalAP/LayingAP, ArrivalCP/LayingCP and ArrivalEP/LayingEP, each species' arrival and laying series in its own columns beside the MSA and SOI indices; the species is the unit stored wide.
One row per boar with Tb, SEX, AgeClass and LengthCT only; no id or cluster column, and the documented model is a logistic GLM of Tb.

One row per Year with Stilt.Oahu, Stilt.Maui, Coot.Oahu, Coot.Maui and Moorhen.Kauai, each species-island abundance series in its own column beside Rainfall; the species-island series are stored wide.
Site is unique, one forest patch per row with ABUND, AREA, DIST, LDIST, YR.ISOL, GRAZE and ALT; GRAZE is a graded covariate, no unit repeats.
ID and Rivername are unique, one river per row; Date/Date2 is the sampling day and Easting/Northing coordinates, so no unit repeats.
Farm is unique, one estate per row with boar and deer positives out of those sampled and habitat covariates; the farm is the observational unit, not a repeated cluster.

One row per Year with the counts of Oystercatcher, Turnstone, Curlew, BartailedGodwit, Redshank, Knot and Dunlin in separate columns beside crop, livestock and nitrate series; the species series are stored wide.

Site is unique, but Year, the survey year of each trawl, holds several sites each and Period splits the years in two; the survey wave is a grouping factor that Zuur's negative binomial GLM of TotAbund leaves out.

ID is unique and replicate numbers the units within each window.duration x stress.type x competition x fertilization cell, the factorial's design index (confirmed by Alex 2026-10-08); the pre-stress and final Triadica columns are one unit's baseline and outcome.
id is unique, one crocodile per row with Survived01 (Survived recoded) on DeltaWeight, Assistance and Position; no unit repeats.
ID is unique, one river per row with Easting/Northing coordinates, Altitude, Forested, pH and SDI; no unit repeats.
id names the cat, one shelter stay per row with days_to_event and out_event; breed and color are attributes and date_in/date_out timestamps, no unit the rows repeat within.
One row per visiting party with fish_caught, livebait, camper, persons, child and hours; persons and child are counts, there is no id column.
One row per person with age.at.death, age, alive, male, height and weight; no id, household or site column.
One hurricane per row (name with year); year is the hurricane's season, an attribute rather than a sampling wave, and the book models deaths on femininity per hurricane.
i is unique, one site per row; n counts detections over the site's repeat visits in one column, with elev and percforest as site covariates.
One row per MONTH x YEAR x AGE cell of census population estimates (with an all-ages total row), the race x sex counts category columns rather than repeated measures; no sampled unit and no response.
One row per Age x Male x Year cell of national mortality (Deaths out of Population, Rate), a complete grid of fixed age, sex and year levels rather than sampled units; no model is fitted.
One row per Age x Male x Year cell of national mortality (Deaths out of Population, Rate), a complete grid of fixed levels rather than sampled units; no model is fitted.
One row per Age x Year cell of national mortality (Deaths out of Population, Rate), a complete grid of fixed levels rather than sampled units; no model is fitted.
One row per Age x Male x Year cell of national mortality (Deaths out of Population, Rate), a complete grid of fixed levels rather than sampled units; no model is fitted.
Id is unique, one well per row with survey answers, X/Y coordinates and counts of nearby wells; no village or household column, and ROS fits a classical logistic switching model.
id ('Well identification number') is unique, one well per row; x/y are coordinates and the rest well and respondent attributes, no community column.
rbd is a unique school id and the scores repeat across years as columns (cas88/cas90/cas92, mat88/mat90/mat92, ncas88/ncas90/ncas92, indice90/indice92); the school is the unit stored wide.
One row per district with the election years as columns (inc86/inc88/inc90, v86/v88/v90, v86_adj/v88_adj/v90_adj); the district is the unit stored wide.
One row per candidate with cumulative vote tallies at successive count rounds as columns (the first candidate's row read as the header); the candidate is the unit stored wide.

One row per cow of the codebook's feed experiment: level is the additive dose, lactation, age and initial.weight pre-treatment, dry, milk and fat outcomes; initial/final weight is a baseline-outcome pair, no unit repeats (the banner lines mis-parse the header).
One row per US state (Unnamed: 0 the state code) with death-row, homicide and execution rates; no unit repeats.
One row per matched pair of classes with treated_pretest/treated_posttest and control_pretest/control_posttest; the pair's two classes and two tests are columns, the long form being electric.csv.
One row per country with doctors' consultations per capita in one column per year (the years a header row); the country is the unit stored wide.
One row per country with total health expenditure per capita in one column per year (the years a header row, flag columns between); the country is the unit stored wide.
One row per country with life expectancy at birth in one column per year (the years a header row, flag columns between); the country is the unit stored wide.

One row per respondent (fproj, odate, samptype, borough, then the questionnaire); borough is a fixed set of New York City boroughs and the _1 to _6 blocks list household members' attributes, not a repeated measure of the respondent.
obs is unique, one bush per row; group is a fixed two-level batch used as a covariate in the classical stan_glm, no sampled cluster.
state ('state of residence') holds many respondents (resid) each, year the survey wave kept fixed; the file is the raw source of the rpackage nes, so it leaves as a duplicate.
One row per name and sex with one count column per year from 1880; the name is the unit stored wide, which names.Rmd reshapes into series.
One row per name and sex with one count column per year (X1880 onward); the name is the unit stored wide.
Unnamed: 0 is a row number, one ceasefire per row with cfdate, faildate, peacekeepers?, badness, delay and censored?; no conflict column, so no unit repeats.

Rows are time-varying spells (t0, t1) of ceasefires (id), and cluster ('conflict cluster') and clust2 ('country cluster') index the conflicts and countries whose ceasefires repeat; a long counting-process table, not wide.

Spells per ceasefire id under cluster ('conflict cluster') and clust2 ('country cluster'), as in pk&pkept.dta, with the Cox fit's hazards and Schoenfeld residuals appended; re-filed as derived or duplicated.
Unnamed: 0 names the conflict and repeats for a conflict's successive ceasefires (Angola, Azerbaijan-N.K.); re-filed as a ceasefire-level reduction of pk&pkept.dta.
One row per metropolitan area with mort, the pollution indices hc, nox and so2 and demographic and climate covariates; no id or grouping column.
Stata twin of pollution.csv, one metropolitan area per row with mort and its covariates; no id or grouping column.
One row per respondent with vote and pid only; pid is a three-party predictor, no sampling cluster.
One row per participant with sex, couples, women_alone, bs_hiv, bupacts and fupacts; no column links a couple's members, so no unit repeats.

person is the participant, voting on a value in each of many rounds (round); ROS fits the ordered logit of vote on value per person, so the participant is a grouping factor whether or not the model pools it.

course_id indexes the multi-section courses whose evaluations repeat, with 0 a catch-all for single-section ones; ROS fits eval ~ beauty + female classically, the course a grouping factor regardless.

One row per school with read92/math92 and their 1988 baselines read88/math88, a baseline-outcome pair rather than a panel; cmb_regn is a fixed combined-region covariate of the regression discontinuity.
One row per district with the election years as columns (inc86/inc88/inc90, v86/v88/v90, v86_adj/v88_adj/v90_adj); the district is the unit stored wide.

rda twin of Poststrat/data/poll.csv, one respondent per row with vote and pid only; no sampling cluster.
rda twin of pollution.csv, one metropolitan area per row with mort and its covariates; no id or grouping column.
V1 names the candidate and V2 to V7 hold cumulative tallies at successive count rounds; the candidate is the unit stored wide.
rda twin of student-merged.csv, one row per student with period grades in two subjects as columns (G1mat/G2mat/G3mat, G1por/G2por/G3por); repeated measures stored wide.
